name: v8_release_4b
description: Candidate 4B release mixture for GFP-S (Tree Forcing, --tree-view statements): breadth (BR-40k, answer-only), the math slice of MS (numgen with the exact Tree Forcing trees of data/student_numgen_tf where the problem is in it, depth <= 4; depth 5-6 and GSM8K-socratic answer-only; no standalone node rows), gold-proof logic (FLD, BoardgameQA, RuleTaker; gold / solver proof trees), rule (program trees), v3sl (K&K solver trees; ShARC, ARC, JustLogic, FOLIO and the policy families answer-only: teacher-written trees). Tier lab: nothing is dropped for its licence class; summary.json counts the lab_only rows (SA / UNK) a release tier would drop.
plan: scripts/build_v8.py; GFP-S eligibility: treeplan.FINAL_QUESTION / statement_block and the tree provenance of each source

answer_only.justlogic: statement block defined; teacher-written tree (p_cot only, not program-checked); 1.9% of nodes restate the judged statement
answer_only.folio: statement block defined; teacher-written tree; 4.8% of nodes restate the judged statement (e.g. 'Is Carlos Reyes an Olympian?')
answer_only.arc_challenge: no clean cut: the question is the whole problem; teacher-written tree
answer_only.arc_easy: no clean cut: the question is the whole problem; teacher-written tree
answer_only.gsm8k_soc: no clean cut: one free-text paragraph whose last sentence can carry premises (program-checked step nodes otherwise)
answer_only.numgen (depth 5-6): items not in data/student_numgen_tf keep their final question only (their data/student_numgen nodes are G3 probes, not a proof tree)

sources.name: kk
sources.comment: K&K with solver proof trees (Tree Forcing data, local fields kept for the local-step probe)
sources.label: as_is
sources.own_eval_comment: val_facts is the v3 val set with stated tree results (diagnostic A10ub): the K&K solver's node phrasing overlaps it in 13-grams; counted, not dropped

sources.name: numgen
sources.comment: the 5000 numgen problems of MS; trees replaced by the exact Tree Forcing trees (read/parse/derive nodes, program truth) for the 3334 problems in data/student_numgen_tf; MS's N1/N4 node rows left out
sources.label: program
sources.own_eval_comment: fa0_* (failure-attribution Tier 0, scripts/build_fa_tier0.py) are trajectories on new numgen problems of the training frames, never equal to a data/student_numgen problem: numgen template overlap like numgen_*, counted, not dropped

sources.name: rule
sources.comment: rule-policy cases (src/cotdistill/rulegen.py), program truth for every node
sources.label: as_is
sources.own_eval_comment: chain_* evals are rendered from the same rulegen domains (condition phrases, Request details layout): 13-gram template overlap, counted, not dropped (as G20 / v5 did for claims/rule rows)

sources.name: goldproof
sources.comment: FLD / BoardgameQA / RuleTaker with gold or solver proof trees, every size tier (lab, release, 4b: all of train.jsonl; no 'where' filter, which would also drop the val rows, which carry no tier); ProofWriter's lab-only file stays out
sources.label: gold

sources.name: v3sl_ao
sources.comment: v3sl without K&K, answer-only (teacher-written trees dropped in train; val keeps them for --eval-subq)
sources.label: as_is

sources.name: gsm8k_soc
sources.comment: the 880 GSM8K-socratic problems of MS, answer-only (no clean statement block); MS's node rows left out
sources.label: gold

sources.name: br40k
sources.comment: BR-40k breadth rows (built and screened by configs/v7/v7_pilot_br40k.json), answer-only; last in priority, so its cross-source duplicates go
sources.label: as_is
